scope: Six hand-checked functional questions, not a statistically meaningful quality benchmark
verification: Relevant source-page text inspected before retrieval. Pumping lemma and BERT pages were also rendered and visually checked. Physical PDF pages are one-based; printed page labels can differ.

queries.query: What fact about finite automata lets me repeat part of a long accepted word without leaving the language?
queries.rationale: The pumping-lemma statement and its finite-state proof.

queries.query: How can a state machine consider several successor states for the same input symbol?
queries.rationale: Nondeterministic transition rules permit several successor states.

queries.query: Which rule turns convolution in time into multiplication of frequency spectra?
queries.rationale: The Fourier/Laplace properties table contains the convolution row.

queries.query: Why are query-key dot products scaled down before the softmax in an attention layer?
queries.rationale: Scaled dot-product attention definition and saturation motivation.

queries.query: How is a model trained to guess hidden tokens from words on both sides?
queries.rationale: Masked-language-model objective, masking procedure and bidirectional context.

queries.query: How do I keep a recursive function from calling itself forever?
queries.rationale: Base cases, recursive stack frames and infinite recursion.
